item.title_tr: A6S TWS Wireless Bluetooth Earphones Noise Cancelling Headset Sports Gaming Office Mic
item.description_tr:
Please note:
 The product has a battery protection function, when the headphone power is 100%. Automatically turn off.
This is not a malfunction, but a normal battery protection function)

The package package includes:
1x Pair of Headphones
1x Charging cable
1x User Manual

 Product specifications
Product Model: A6S
Bluetooth compatible version: V5.3
Headphone type: headphone type
Playback time: about 3 hours
Connection time: about 4 hours
Vocal trail system: stereo
Support mode support support: HFP / HSP / A2DP / AVRCP
Sensitivity sensitivity: 105dB + 3dB S P L at 1KHz
Waterproof: IPX4
Transmission distance: 10 meters (in an ideal environment without major obstacles)
Standby time: about 80 hours
Battery specification: headphone 3.7V / 45mAh; 7V / 250mAh charging box
Charging time: charge the charging compartment for about 1.5 hours
Charge the headset for about 1 hour
Charging box for charging the headset: about 2.5 times



Product Description:
 Listening to music and phone calls, supporting listening to music and making calls.
 Call call ID number, smart English full tone prompt, power, pairing, shutdown, low power, etc.
 Each time the headset is connected to the phone, the headset will automatically connect to the phone when it is turned on, which is convenient and faster.
 Smart Tablet Compatibility: Support all mobile phones with function, tablet, notebook, device, all mobile phones.
 Button function: long press to power, long press to turn off, click music pause/game/call answer/hang up the phone.
